cause: The main workflow's shipment-source function uses (get input "order_id") as the reservation_id instead of using the actual reservation result from inventory/reserve. inventory/reserve returns reservation_id "reservation:order-17" but shipment-source passes plain "order-17" to shipping/schedule, causing the reservation_id comparison in run to fail and trigger the reservation-routing-mismatch failure.

main workflow shipment-source: (str "(return (shipping/schedule " (pr-str {"reservation_id" (get input "order_id") "destination" (get input "destination")}) "))") — uses input order_id not reservation result
inventory/reserve returns: {"reservation_id" (str "reservation:" (get request "order_id")) "item" (get request "item")} — so reservation_id is "reservation:order-17"
main run checks (= (get shipment "reservation_id") (get reservation "reservation_id")) — fails because shipment has "order-17" but reservation has "reservation:order-17"
